name: TimelineChart
description: Discrete-event timeline chart (e.g. miner state over time) with a category legend. Supports streaming updates via `newData`

props.name: newData
props.description: Streaming updates appended to the initial data

fields.name: labels
fields.description: Row labels, one row each; a data point lands in the row whose label equals its `y`. Nothing renders when empty

fields.name: datasets
fields.description: Bar series; each dataset's `label` is its tooltip title and legend entry

fields.name: min
fields.description: Left edge of the time axis (`Date` or epoch ms); without a range the axis spans the data

fields.name: max
fields.description: Right edge of the time axis (`Date` or epoch ms)

fields.name: x
fields.description: Title under the time axis; hidden when empty

fields.name: y
fields.description: Title beside the row labels; hidden when empty
